snippet.title: Lone Soul // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237360/Lone_Soul/

Lone Soul is a fast-paced hack-and-slash roguelite with fluid combo-driven combat and rune-based skills customization. Shape unique builds in every run as a conqueror battling through a mythical tower to save an innocent soul trapped within.

Developed by
Laughing Fox Games aka @laughingfoxgames
